test: HTTP page writer retries preserve one acquisition and one observation
localReproduction: Vitest run of coding-poll-writer.test.ts: 1 failed, 4 passed
cause: The fault injector uses the Bun-specific inTransaction property to exclude the nested savepoint. Node SQLite uses a private transaction depth, so the fixture counts the nested invocation as another outer attempt.
